base_rules.name: has_bank_loan
base_rules.condition: has_bank_loan is yes and policy_type is credit/tax/compliance
base_rules.reason: SME has a banking relationship that may be affected.

base_rules.name: loan_renewal
base_rules.condition: loan_stage is renewal and policy mentions renewal/cashflow/revenue
base_rules.reason: SME is near loan renewal and policy affects required documents.

base_rules.name: missing_required_documents
base_rules.reason: Policy requires documents currently missing or incomplete.

base_rules.name: unstable_cashflow
base_rules.condition: cashflow_status is unstable or seasonal and policy mentions cashflow

base_rules.name: weak_tax_status
base_rules.condition: tax_compliance_status is low/medium and policy mentions tax/invoice
base_rules.reason: Tax or invoice readiness may affect compliance and loan review.

base_rules.name: digital_invoice_gap
base_rules.condition: digital_invoice_status is partial/not_ready and policy mentions invoice
base_rules.reason: Digital invoice records are not fully ready.
